history.dynasty: Modern (Kanchi Kamakoti Peetam; Sri Subrahmanyaswamy Aadi Krithikai Laksharchana Committee / Sri Subramanyaswamy Sanathana Dharma Trust)
history.period: Modern - shankusthapanam 18 May 1968; Sundara Vinayagar Maha Kumbhabhishekam 26 August 1968; Sri Subrahmanyaswamy Maha Kumbhabhishekam 22 January 1970 (Thai Poosam)
history.summary: The best-supported referent for CSV row 982 is the Skandagiri Sri Subrahmanyaswamy Devalayam on the Skandagiri hillock at Kamakotinagar, Padmarao Nagar, Secunderabad. In April 1968, when Kanchi Paramacharya Sri Chandrasekharendra Saraswati Swamigal camped at the Swarajya Press premises in Secunderabad, the Sri Subrahmanyaswamy Aadi Krithikai Laksharchana Committee sought his blessings for a temple site; His Holiness chose a small hillock in Padmarao Nagar, and its owner Sri Ennala Balaram readily donated the land. On 18 May 1968 the Paramacharya performed the shankusthapanam for both the Sundara Vinayagar and Sri Subrahmanyaswamy temples; the Vinayagar temple was completed first with the Maha Kumbhabhishekam on 26 August 1968 (major donation by Smt & Sri V. Seshadri), and the Sri Subrahmanyaswamy Maha Kumbhabhishekam was performed on Thai Poosam day, 22 January 1970, by Sahithya Kartha Kalaimaamani Sri Swarna Venkatesa Dikshatar of Chidambaram (major contribution by Smt. Lakshmi Rajalingam Mudaliar of Bolarum). Padmashri Ganapathy Sthapathy was the Pradhaana Sthapathy. Since November 2013 the temple is under the sole trusteeship of the Sri Subramanyaswamy Sanathana Dharma Trust under the aegis of Sri Kanchi Kamakoti Peetam, Kanchipuram. The temple is believed to relieve Angaraka/Kuja doshas and Kaala Sarpa doshas, and is a landmark of the twin cities in Tamil-style architecture. CSV STATE FLAG: the CSV state 'Tamil Nadu' is an error - the temple is in Secunderabad, TELANGANA. The confusion likely arose because the temple is under the aegis of the Sri Kanchi Kamakoti Peetam of KANCHIPURAM, TAMIL NADU (its management page lists the Peetam at Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu). Corrected to Telangana.

name: Sri Subrahmanyaswamy Temple (Skandagiri)
town_description: Secunderabad is the twin city of Hyderabad in the Hyderabad Urban Agglomeration, Telangana. The Skandagiri temple stands on a small hillock at Kamakotinagar, Padmarao Nagar, behind Gandhi Hospital near Sardar Patel College (Secunderabad 500061), a few km from Secunderabad railway station.

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad - about 35-40 km (verify).
travel.railway: Secunderabad Junction railway station - about 3-5 km from the temple (verify).
travel.road: In Padmarao Nagar, Secunderabad; accessible by bus and auto from Secunderabad station; parking available at the foothill.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather; Thai Poosam (Jan-Feb) and Skanda Shashti (Oct-Nov) are the grandest festival days.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Open 6:00 AM to 12:00 noon and 4:00 PM to 8:30 PM (per yatradham listing; verify before visiting). Special poojas on Sashti days, Tuesdays and festival days; modest traditional dress expected; photography not allowed inside.
